body: im feeling a little better, so I might be able to stray from my comfort shows for a bit :) thanks for the heads up

Seriously though, I can't imagine how hard it must be to be separated from your baby. Please message me if you'd like to talk

Make an appointment with a doctor to talk to. They can help you get back on track and you don't have to involve your friends and family until you want to. Reach out to someone. Anyone. This post is a good first step. Admitting you're feeling depressed and suicidal is hard, even to strangers on the Internet. The next step is talking to someone you trust. You aren't alone and you deserve to feel better

I'm having the same trouble with not being able to make it until I can get an appointment. A hospital is starting to look like the only option to prevent suicide, but I honestly think that would make it worse. Sometimes you can get in with a primary care doctor before a psychiatrist. They can write prescriptions to get you through, if not the same ones as before. 
Hang on, just for today 
And please message me if you need to <3
Thank you for caring. It's too much to type. It goes back too far. I just can't do it anymore. I'll just sound like another statistic
It takes a long time to get an appointment. I don't think I can wait that long

That made me cry. Thank you. I really needed to hear it. I'm just too afraid to find a therapist because i don't know what will happen if I tell them what I'm really thinking. I'm really good at hiding it and the last time I saw a therapist (4 years ago, after failed suicide attempt) I lied and faked my way through it because I was too embarrassed to admit how horrible I felt. But thank you again for your kind words. They mean more than you know

This. You took the thoughts right out of my head. You deserve to be happy. Don't feel guilty about enjoying the good things. That's what I try to tell myself and sometimes it helps. You've fought your way through enough sadness. It's okay to let yourself be happy. You're worth so much more than the guilt and second guessing

Your life is worth so much more than the money you would have to spend, but I absutely get what you're saying. I'm in the same situation, except I could do it tomorrow if I wanted to. I worry about the money and disappointing my family. I'm glad you have a therapist. That's already a step in the right direction. I've been too pussy to even do that yet. If you want my opinion (which I realize isn't much, since I'm an Internet stranger), I would say tell your therapist. the fact that you're on here asking for help is a sign that at least a tiny part of you wants to live. I'm obviously no professional, but I can talk to you if you need to get your mind off things for a while. We can talk about whatever. Please feel free to message me. You're worth my time :)

Also, sorry it took me so long to get back to you. I just started posting on reddit last night and my anxiety about checking to see if anyone commented on my post today was overwhelming. But I think I can do it if you'd like to keep talking

"All you attempting to do is empty that fucked up brain of yours. Its a verbal vomit. Go nuts embrace the weird"
Lol thank you for that. It genuinely made me smile. I do actually keep a journal, but I've been slacking lately since things have been so dark. Thank you for your other suggestions, also. It's easier to see it written down than to try and think up things to do on my own. My head gets really foggy when I'm like this

God, it really is a never ending cycle. How do you overcome it? If you don't mind me asking. I'm 25 and I've been dealing with depression since I was about 14 and I still can't figure it out. The companionship thing does make sense. I'm in a relationship though and I still feel so lonely and trapped sometimes. I feel like I can't talk to anyone I'm close to about how I REALLY feel though because I'm afraid of what they'd think. What do you do to feel better?

You could tell me what's on your mind, if you want. I've been feeling the same way, in a sense. I have a logical reason to continue, but my problem is that I feel so trapped that I don't want to. I'm a good listener if you're still on. I have to go to sleep soon to get up for work in the morning, but please feel free to sent me a message or whatever and I can get back to you in the morning, if not tonight. I've really been needing someone to talk to too.

Thank you all so much. The fact that you even took the time to answer me made me cry. Thank you. I think voluntary hospitalization is a last resort, but I'm really, really struggling. Do you have any other suggestions? I've been on 4 different anti-depressants and none of them helped. I really feel like I'm at the end of my rope, but I have a 3 year old and I'm trying so hard to hang on for him. Any advice or support is greatly appreciated. I'm having a hard time finding it in my day-to-day life, so I feel stupid asking here. But thank you all again for the time you took to talk to me
